scope: Autonomous scientific discovery and AI-for-science systems using LLMs or language-model agents
Closed-loop hypothesis generation, experiment design or execution, result analysis, and iterative refinement
LLM-based research agents, multi-agent scientist systems, and automated machine-learning or algorithm-discovery systems when they exhibit the full research loop
Applications in machine learning, computational science, biology, chemistry, and other empirical sciences
Evaluation of autonomy, novelty, correctness, reproducibility, efficiency, and human involvement
exclusions: Exclude papers that only propose LLM-generated hypotheses without experiment execution or result-driven iteration.
Exclude generic autonomous-agent frameworks, coding agents, or scientific assistants unless they are evaluated on a research loop matching the scope.
Exclude papers where experiments are only simulated examples with no meaningful evaluation of the autonomous process, unless they provide a clearly useful methodological foundation.
Exclude opinion pieces, blog posts, and non-research demos unless needed to locate the corresponding primary paper.
constraints: Prioritize systems that implement an end-to-end loop: LLM agents generate or select hypotheses, execute experiments or evaluations, interpret results, and use feedback to improve subsequent research actions.
Require concrete empirical demonstrations with reported results, artifacts, benchmarks, or reproducible experimental procedures.
Include both single-agent and multi-agent systems, but label the distinction and identify which components are automated versus human-controlled.
Prefer primary research papers and authoritative preprints from 2023 onward; include earlier foundational work only when directly necessary to explain the lineage.
Extract the research domain, hypothesis representation, experiment execution mechanism, evaluation protocol, iteration strategy, and level of human involvement.

searchDirections.query: LLM autonomous scientist hypothesis generation experiment execution iterative improvement paper
searchDirections.reason: Find primary papers describing complete autonomous research loops.

searchDirections.reason: Capture systems framed as closed-loop scientific discovery or hypothesis testing.

searchDirections.query: multi-agent LLM scientist research experiment evaluation paper
searchDirections.reason: Find multi-agent research systems with explicit coordination and iterative evaluation.

searchDirections.query: LLM automated machine learning research agent generate test improve algorithms paper
searchDirections.reason: Include algorithm-discovery and automated-ML systems when they instantiate the target research loop.

screeningCriteria: The paper describes an implemented system or a sufficiently specified prototype, not only a conceptual architecture.
The system contains at least three linked stages among hypothesis generation, experiment planning or execution, result evaluation, and iterative improvement; prioritize papers covering all four.
The paper reports experiments that test the system's research behavior or scientific outputs.
The paper makes clear what the LLM controls, what tools or environments it uses, and where humans intervene.
The paper provides enough methodological detail to compare its loop, evaluation, and limitations with other systems.
For each recommendation, classify loop completeness, domain, agent structure, tool use, evaluation strength, and reproducibility.
